basic_info.description: Sexy & sophisticated luxury Art Deco high-rise condominium at the apex of Nob Hill with sunset vistas. Encompassing the entire front half of the 5th floor with windows on 3 sides, this home in The Clay-Jones, circa 1929, has outstanding light from 13 windows facing south, west, and north, with outlooks toward the Grace Cathedral & landmark hotels, and peek-a-boo outlooks of the Bay. Modern & crisp, yet elegantly understated with dentil molding, newly refinished hardwood floors, high ceilings, built-in bookshelves, office, walk-in closets, and in-unit laundry. The rooms are generous entertaining spaces with classic City architecture. Recently updated and refreshed with all new kitchen appliances, while the spacious bath has a separate tub and shower enclosure. Remarkably low monthly dues are inclusive of 24/7 door person, parking, all utilities, basic cable, extra storage, common sun deck, and exterior window washing. Hear the bells of Grace Cathedral, ride nearby historic cable cars, or walk the doggie at charming Huntington Park 1.5 blocks away. Easy access to Union Square, FiDi, or bistros & boutiques of Polk Street and North Beach. Adjacent to the electric 1 CA line straight to FiDi, with easy access to SOMA. Ideal lock-and-go lifestyle or chic City home.
